capability_feature_titles: Customer authentication via the existing identity provider
Online review of existing personal motor and home insurance policies
Online submission of policy renewal requests
Triggering of confirmation emails via the existing email delivery service

functional_requirements: The system shall allow eligible customers to review existing personal motor and home insurance policies online via a secure web portal.
The system shall allow eligible customers to submit renewal requests for existing insurance policies online.
The system shall retrieve policy information from and submit renewal requests to the existing policy administration system.
The system shall authenticate customers using the existing identity provider.
The system shall utilize the existing email delivery service to send confirmation emails.

Definitive internal customer service application updates beyond potential future visibility enhancements
